title: Ratio card
description: A key ratio as a large figure, with its label and the configuration that gives it. Two to four side by side, for example in the cards slot of the hero layout.
instructions: Keep the label to one or two words and the body to one sentence. The value is a figure with its operator (÷ 3.6, × 3.6, − 2.6). Pick a different accent per card in a row.

body.description: One sentence: the configuration that gives this ratio.

accent.description: Colour of the figure and of the top edge (a colour token of the theme).

props.label: Reduce
props.body: Ring held, the sun drives the carrier.

props.body: Carrier held, the sun drives the ring.
